info.title: Vernatun API
info.description: Local Vernatun API: authenticated role-scoped operations. Existing detailed schemas plus route inventory for expanded modules. For new route request/response validation see the referenced Zod schemas in server source. Cookie sessions; mutations require CSRF. External integrations are not connected.
